title: Bride and Mother Outdoor Portrait, 1948 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: Full-length outdoor portrait taken on July 5, 1948, featuring a young bride or debutante in a ruffled white gown standing alongside an older woman in a floral dress and eyeglasses. Set in a grassy field with utility poles and industrial buildings visible in the background, this photo offers a clear view of post-WWII American formal wear and family life.
